description: Change application and project performance settings: memory limits (Preferences > Memory & Performance), the project's Mercury GPU acceleration (File > Project Settings), whether preferences are saved on quit, and the preferences the scripting guide documents (expand flowchart compositions, JavaScript debugger)

gpuAcceleration.description: Project GPU acceleration; must be one the computer offers (see get_aftereffects_info)

imageCachePercent.description: Image cache size as a percent of memory; give with maximumMemoryPercent

javascriptDebugger.description: Scripting & Expressions: enable the JavaScript debugger

maximumMemoryPercent.description: Maximum memory After Effects may use, as a percent of installed RAM; the rest stays reserved for other applications

savePreferencesOnQuit.description: Save preferences when After Effects quits

name: set_application_settings
title: Set Application Settings
